nodes.name: Hermes Authenticate
nodes.notes: POST /api/authenticate {username,password} -> { access_token }. Creds from n8n ENV (HERMES_BASE_URL / HERMES_USERNAME / HERMES_PASSWORD).

nodes.name: Hermes POST Catalogue
nodes.notes: POST /api/productsCatalogue { items:[...] } — ONE request for the whole selection. Hermes returns, per item, its internal id AND (since 2026-07-31) a Code field holding the item code; hermes_id stores the CODE. A skipped item no longer stops the run — the algorithm continues with the remaining items (Jože, 2026-07-31). 200 ok / 401 bad token / 422 processing error {msg,error}.
